name: Microcredit Finance Scheme- Self Help Groups (DAADC)
benefit: - **Loan Amount:** Up to ₹50,000/- (maximum ₹5,00,000/-)- **Interest Rate:** 6% annually- **Loan Tenure:** 36 months (3 years)- **State Government Share:** 95% (₹47,500/-)- **Beneficiary Share:** 5% (₹2,500/-)- **Guarantor:** Not required- **Possible Installment amount :** ₹1,445/- per month.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) community. 1. The applicant must be part of an Antyodaya (AAY) family. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a self-help group of unemployed persons. 1. The applicant must be a member of a registered self-help group (SHG) or apply individually with valid business intent.
